text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on lower CBOT soybean calls, large NOPA crush numbers with the trade waiting for the COPA crush statistics Friday. July WCE futures crush profit margin fell to -12.97 Monday from -12.14 Friday. Sell stops were expected in the July at C$420/tonne.

New crop canola should find support on reduced acreage expectations to the level of early forecasts of 12.1 million to 12.2 million acres versus prior trade expectations of 13.5 to 14.0 million. Speculation should soon turn to April 30 Statistics Canada March seeding intentions report.
The Canadian dollar opened up at C$1.3984 and rose against Japan's yen at 90.35 from 87.61.
FLAX - Steady to C$0.60 down in the July on hedges expected to be met with local short covering and on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on sooner than expected seeding projections in western Saskatchewan where intended acreage estimates were only five percent lower than the prior year.
FEED WHEAT - Steady on expected strength in U.S. wheat.
PEAS/OATS - Steady to US$0.50 down on allied markets.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
